hlg.name: Enable efficient supplier onboarding and proposal management
hlg.description: Ensure suppliers can register, submit product proposals with detailed information, and receive timely feedback or revisions to improve product availability and streamline procurement.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable suppliers to register their accounts, submit product proposals with detailed specifications, and resubmit revised proposals within a defined timeframe in response to administrative feedback.

hlg.name: Ensure timely evaluation and decision-making on supplier proposals
hlg.description: Provide administrators with tools to evaluate supplier proposals within defined timeframes, including automatic rejection for delays, to maintain operational efficiency and product quality.

branches.hlg_prime: The system enables administrators to review and assign statuses to supplier proposals, while automatically rejecting proposals that exceed their evaluation deadlines.

hlg.name: Ensure real-time inventory tracking and automated replenishment to maintain optimal stock levels across stores
hlg.description: Enable administrators to configure reorder thresholds and automatic replenishment rules, trigger reorder requests upon inventory depletion, and monitor real-time stock levels to prevent stockouts while avoiding overstocking.

branches.hlg_prime: Implement an automated inventory replenishment system that enables administrators to configure reorder thresholds, triggers automatic reorder requests upon stock depletion, sends those requests to predefined suppliers with confirmation deadlines, and maintains real-time inventory visibility across all store locations.

hlg.name: Facilitate seamless goods receiving and store placement
hlg.description: Allow goods-receiving staff to verify deliveries, assign products to store locations, and flag defective items for exclusion, ensuring accurate product presentation in stores.

branches.hlg_prime: Goods-Receiving Staff scans deliveries, assigns items to store locations based on system suggestions, and flags defective items for exclusion with logged reasons.

hlg.name: Manage order fulfillment and supplier payments accurately
hlg.description: Enable the order department to process completed orders, handle partial deliveries, and manage supplier payments based on delivery status to ensure financial accuracy and customer satisfaction.

branches.hlg_prime: Order Department Staff manages order completion and delivery status by initiating payment upon full delivery, updating status and adjusting inventory upon partial delivery, and ensuring supplier payment is triggered only when delivery is confirmed complete.

hlg.name: Provide seamless online shopping and payment experience
hlg.description: Allow customers to browse, purchase, and pay for products online using multiple payment methods, with real-time order tracking and delivery notifications.

branches.hlg_prime: Customer navigates a product catalog to select items, adds them to a shopping cart, selects a payment method, and completes the checkout process to finalize an order.

hlg.name: Deliver responsive and efficient customer support
hlg.description: Enable customer-service agents to manage support tickets with timely responses, automatic reassignment, and performance tracking to ensure high customer satisfaction.

branches.hlg_prime: Customer-Service Agent creates, assigns, updates, and logs resolution of support tickets.

hlg.name: Support data-driven business decision-making
hlg.description: Collect and analyze operational data (orders, sales, inventory, support) to inform strategic decisions, optimize processes, and improve overall business performance.

branches.hlg_prime: Administrator generates and exports predefined operational performance reports covering sales, inventory turnover, and customer support response metrics.
